author: nincreativestudio
title: NIN Creative Studio Hiring Illustrator Artists
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: datavaleai
title: DataVale AI Hiring Graphic Illustrators for Character Design
content: 🔥🎨 WE’RE HIRING GRAPHIC ILLUSTRATORS - FULLY REMOTE! Are you passionate about digital art, character design, and visual storytelling? DataVale AI is looking for talented Graphic Illustrators to join our AI-powered creative projects! Character design & expressions, professional digital illustration & clean linework, shading, contrast & visual storytelling, character consistency & attention to detail. Work remotely from anywhere! Immediate joining | Limited spots available. Head over to our LinkedIn post for the full details and application link: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/datavaleai_hiring-graphicillustrator-graphicdesign-activity-7519661451972886528-Nr-L

author: egofilm_studio
title: EGoFILM Seeking Lead and Background Illustrators for Animated Series
content: 🎬 EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora! Do nowego projektu serialu animowanego szukamy osoby, która będzie odpowiedzialna między innymi za: projektowanie i rozwijanie lokacji oraz backgroundów (background ilustrator), współtworzenie warstwy wizualnej serialu (lead ilustrator), dbanie o spójność stylistyczną ilustracji (lead ilustrator), współpracę z Art Directorem, reżyserami oraz zespołem ilustratorów (lead ilustrator). Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na: rekrutacja@egofilm.pl

author: ctfdn_official
title: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights Seeking Paid Horror Illustrators
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: rachel_recruits
title: Seeking Designers and Painters for Titmouse Horror Series
content: Just posted! Seeking a few designers and painters for our horror series in Vancouver! Applicants must be based in BC, although the team may consider applicants in Canada but outside of BC on a freelance basis. We are NOT looking for cute or cartoony samples, please apply with relevant samples! Titmouse.net/careers
